marketOverview.digitalPaymentsAdoption: 89% of payments are digital (up from 7% in 2014)
marketOverview.onlineBankingUsers: 23.1 million active online banking users (4.6x growth from 2019 to 2023)
marketOverview.cashlessTransactions: 98% of transactions are non-cash as of 2025
marketOverview.source: National Bank of Kazakhstan, NPCK, RISE Research Fintech Kazakhstan 2024 report

competitors.name: Kaspi.kz
competitors.targetMarket: Mass market consumers and merchants in Kazakhstan, expanding to Turkiye, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Ukraine
productOffering: Kaspi Super App (payments, marketplace, fintech, government services)
Kaspi Pay (P2P transfers, QR payments, merchant acquiring)
competitors.fundingStatus: Publicly traded on NASDAQ since 2024. Acquired 65.41% of Hepsiburada (Turkiye) for $1.13B in early 2025.
keyDifferentiators: Dominant super app with unmatched daily engagement (75 transactions/month/user)
Integrated payments + marketplace + fintech ecosystem
Deep government services integration
Cross-border expansion strategy (100M user ambition)
QR payment interoperability with Alipay+
competitors.marketPosition: Dominant market leader. Kaspi is the de facto digital payments platform in Kazakhstan with near-universal adoption.

competitors.name: Halyk Bank
competitors.targetMarket: Mass market retail and corporate banking, expanding digital lifestyle services
productOffering: Halyk Super App (B2C financial, lifestyle, payment solutions)
QR code payments via UnionPay (first in Central Asia)
competitors.fundingStatus: Publicly traded. Largest bank in Kazakhstan by assets. Founded 1923.
keyDifferentiators: Largest bank in Kazakhstan by assets
Highest credit ratings among private KZ banks without foreign participation
First Central Asian bank to launch UnionPay QR payments
Significant B2B client base (459K active)
Legacy trust and institutional strength
competitors.marketPosition: Second-largest player by digital reach. Strongest institutional trust. Competing with Kaspi on super app features while leveraging banking license advantages.

competitors.name: Freedom Pay (freedompay.kz)
competitors.targetMarket: Online businesses, merchants, and banks in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan
productOffering: Card payment processing for online businesses
Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay integration
competitors.fundingStatus: Part of Freedom Holding Corp. (NASDAQ: FRHC), a publicly traded diversified financial services company. Parent company has $1.13B+ in annual revenue.
keyDifferentiators: Part of broader Freedom ecosystem (brokerage, banking, insurance, lifestyle)
International payment provider with Central Asian regional presence
Strong developer documentation and API-first approach
Full-stack payment infrastructure (gateway, acquiring, issuing)
Cross-border commerce capability (KZ-China via UnionPay partnership)
competitors.marketPosition: Leading independent payment gateway in Central Asia. Positioned as the merchant-facing payment infrastructure layer, competing indirectly with Kaspi by enabling businesses to accept payments independently.

competitors.name: Bank CenterCredit (BCC)
competitors.targetMarket: Retail and corporate banking, digital-first customers
productOffering: UnionPay card transfers (first in KZ to launch)
Super App in development with Ant Group Digital

keyMetrics.status: One of Kazakhstan's oldest and largest banks
keyMetrics.ebdrd_loan_2024: US$60 million EBRD facility secured in 2024
keyMetrics.digitalTransformation: Partnered with Tuum for core banking modernization

competitors.fundingStatus: Established bank, backed by EBRD ($60M loan in 2024). Strategic partnership with Ant Group Digital Technologies (March 2024) for SuperApp development.
keyDifferentiators: Strategic partnership with Ant Group Digital Technologies for SuperApp
Using Tuum core banking platform for digital transformation
First in Kazakhstan to launch UnionPay card transfers
Early adopter of Digital Tenge for business wallets
WeChat Pay integration for Chinese tourist/trade payments
competitors.marketPosition: Aggressive digital challenger. Ant Group partnership positions BCC as a potential Kaspi competitor with Chinese fintech backing. Currently in transformation phase.

competitors.name: Eurasian Bank
competitors.targetMarket: Retail banking customers, expats, and small businesses in Kazakhstan
productOffering: Mobile banking app (trilingual: Kazakh, Russian, English)
competitors.fundingStatus: Established commercial bank in Kazakhstan. No major external funding rounds reported.
keyDifferentiators: Trilingual mobile app (Kazakh, Russian, English) - targeting expat market
Simplified digital onboarding
FX-focused services
Mid-market positioning between mega-banks and fintech startups
competitors.marketPosition: Mid-tier digital banking competitor. Focused on serving the expat and multilingual community in Kazakhstan. Smaller scale than Kaspi or Halyk but actively digitizing.

competitors.name: Digital Tenge (CBDC)
competitors.operator: National Bank of Kazakhstan (NBK) / National Payment Corporation of Kazakhstan (NPCK)
competitors.targetMarket: All participants in Kazakhstan's financial system (government, banks, businesses, consumers)
productOffering: Token-based CBDC (third form of national currency)

keyMetrics.governmentBudgetTransition: All government budgets transitioning to Digital Tenge starting 2026
keyMetrics.recognition: Won Currency Research award for 'Leadership in Digital Currencies Adoption' (2024)
keyMetrics.imfAssessment: Most advanced CBDC implementation after two pilot programs (IMF, 2024)

competitors.fundingStatus: Government-backed initiative. No external funding needed.
keyDifferentiators: Only CBDC in Central Asia at production scale
Programmable money - funds can only be spent on designated purposes
Government mandate for budget integration
Token-level programmability for smart contracts
Designed to complement (not replace) existing payment systems
competitors.marketPosition: Infrastructure layer that will reshape the entire payments ecosystem. Not a direct competitor to aipay.kz but a critical platform that any new payment service must integrate with. Sets the rules of the game.

ecosystem.openBanking: Open API initiative led by NBK Chief Digital Officer Binur Zhalenov
ecosystem.marketSize: 89% digital payments adoption, 98% cashless transactions, 200+ fintech startups

barriersToEntry: Kaspi's near-monopoly on daily consumer engagement (75 transactions/month/user)
Network effects from 14.5M MAU super app ecosystem
opportunities: Open Banking API initiative creating new integration points
Digital Tenge programmable money enabling new use cases
Niche segments underserved by Kaspi (specific verticals, SME tools)
Ant Group/BCC partnership proving Chinese fintech entry is possible
threats: Kaspi's expansion into every adjacent vertical
Halyk Bank's institutional trust and scale
Digital Tenge potentially commoditizing basic payment rails
